ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" -- .; else exit 1; fi
